metric_protocol: pooled five-fold out-of-fold evaluation, 3 training seeds (42, 1, 2), fold partition fixed at the seed-42 split

architecture.note: Both datasets run the identical architecture, including the injection mechanism. injection_scale and top_k_percent are the two per-dataset quantities, each selected on validation folds under that same mechanism and never carried across datasets.

headline: No rung comparison is separated on either dataset once training-seed variance is included. Orderings by 3-seed mean: UNSW LLM < GNN < Loop < AGAF; ToN LLM < AGAF < GNN < Loop. Absolute levels are not comparable across datasets (10 vs 8 scored classes); only the shape is.
notes: Absolute macro-F1 levels are not interchangeable across datasets because eval-class counts differ (UNSW 10 vs ToN 8).
The ladder holds on UNSW-NB15 (GNN<LLM<AGAF<Loop by point estimate; loop-vs-AGAF gap CI still touches zero, P=0.778).

The ladder does NOT hold on ToN-IoT, but not for the reason it used to: AGAF now sits BELOW the GNN rung (P=0.0005), and the loop is the TOP rung on ToN, significantly above AGAF (P=1.000). The regression is AGAF's, not the loop's.

Trained-head LLM-only baselines are reported separately in results/{unsw_nb15,ton_iot}_head_baseline.json. Those baseline files were generated 2026-08-20, on the v1 encoding and pre-fusion-fix architecture, and have not been re-run on v2 — treat their exact values as approximate until re-verified, though on both datasets the qualitative finding (trained head beats the full loop) is expected to still hold given the loop's v2 gains are modest relative to the baseline's margin.

Schema 4 re-runs both datasets on the v2 edge-attribute encoding (log1p+Z-score continuous columns, learned embeddings for protocol/port) with the loop-fusion fairness fix (fusion_dim matches AGAF's projection dim; prototype path uses the same confidence gate as the trained-head path). Schema 3 was produced on the v1 encoding.
2026-09-06: superseded single-seed schema 3/5 contracts with 3-seed condition-A measurements; see each contract's supersedes block.
datasets_note: macro_f1 = single seed-42 run (matches each contract's results block, for reproduce_ladder); macro_f1_3seed_mean/std = the reported headline (matches multi_seed).
